units.source_text: 他想去找口水喝，下了地。

en.t: He wanted to find a sip of water, so he got out of bed.

units.source_text: 摸到水缸处一看，水缸底部还有一点水，红红地泛着铁锈斑的颜色。

en.t: When he felt his way to the water jar and looked inside, there was still a little water at the bottom, reddish with the color of rust stains.

units.source_text: 尽管看起来不干净，但总比嘴里沙沙的要好一点。

en.t: Although it did not look clean, it was still better than the gritty feeling in his mouth.

units.source_text: 他又用喝剩下的水，洗了把脸，擦了擦颈脖子，心情好多了。

en.t: He then used the water left after drinking to wash his face and wipe his neck, and he felt much better.
